game_id_first_character: Every GAME_ID in LOCAL_PLAYER_GAME_FACTS has 8 characters, and the first one takes 4 values: 1 (49,628 rows), 2 (577,985 rows), 4 (40,377 rows), 5 (349 rows). The first character is a code, such as a type: filter on it with CAST(GAME_ID AS VARCHAR) LIKE '2%'.

season_is_start_year: SEASON is the year a season starts: in LOCAL_PLAYER_GAME_FACTS, SEASON 2012 runs from 2012-10-06 to 2013-06-20 (19 of 20 seasons span two calendar years this way). Rows whose GAME_ID starts with 4 (40,377 rows) or 5 (349 rows) all fall in the calendar year after their SEASON (SEASON 2012's 4 rows run 2013-04-20 to 2013-06-20): for those rows, calendar year Y is SEASON Y − 1, so the 4, 5 rows of 2013 are SEASON 2012.

season_short_periods: In LOCAL_PLAYER_GAME_FACTS, a typical season holds 34,175 rows (20 seasons, 2003–2022); 2003 holds 89%, 2011 holds 83%, 2022 holds 42% (the latest, through 2022-12-22). Compare those seasons with care.

player_season_sums_every_game_id: LOCAL_PLAYER_SEASON_FACTS adds up every row of LOCAL_PLAYER_GAME_FACTS, every first character of GAME_ID included: TOTAL_FIELD_GOALS_MADE totals 2,004,738, as FIELD_GOALS_MADE does in LOCAL_PLAYER_GAME_FACTS. team_season_sums_every_game_id: LOCAL_TEAM_SEASON_FACTS adds up every row of LOCAL_TEAM_GAME_FACTS, every first character of GAME_ID included: TOTAL_POINTS totals 5,412,766, as TEAM_POINTS does in LOCAL_TEAM_GAME_FACTS.
